title.rendered: Norwalk, CT Education and Testing Center

content.rendered:
See why we built our test center and how it benefits our MRF customers and consumer packagers alike.

Van Dyk built this recycling testing facility, the largest of its kind in the world, to help our customers be more profitable and successful.
